facts.scope_guard: A consultation direction identifies a referral process and is not a substantive planning decision.

facts.scope_guard: Safeguarding protects a possible route from conflicting development and is not funding, construction commencement or delivery evidence.

scope_guards: Safeguarding is primarily a consultation and route-protection mechanism and is not automatic refusal.
Safeguarded wharf status does not prove current operation, spare freight capacity, ownership or title extent.
A Mayor or TfL referral is not a final planning decision.
Statutory blight eligibility is separate from planning permission, ownership and project delivery.
The issuing of rail safeguarding directions is not a government funding commitment.
Aerodrome maps may trigger consultation on height, design or hazards and are not generic development prohibitions.
Historic direction dates and page updates are retained and are not silently presented as new project commitment.
No score or promotion is written without exact current safeguarding map, proposal parameters, consultation response, planning and title evidence.
